source: Cost Explorer SERVICE dimension values, verified verbatim in official AWS pages: get-dimension-values / API_GetDimensionValues examples (EC2 - Other, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud - Compute, Amazon ElastiCache, Amazon DynamoDB), API_GetCostAndUsage (Amazon Simple Storage Service), API_GetReservationUtilization (Amazon Relational Database Service, Amazon Redshift), API_budgets_CreateBudget (AWS Shield), the AWS Cloud Operations blog 'Visualizing Amazon CloudWatch costs, part 2' (AmazonCloudWatch). AWS Lambda is the contract's own example. EBS volumes, snapshots, Elastic IPs and NAT gateways bill under EC2 - Other (AWS CFM blog, Cost Explorer tips part 2), so they count as ec2. Aurora bills under Amazon Relational Database Service.
note: Anything not in `map` is 'other' in city.bill. `unverified` holds likely strings no official page states verbatim: confirm with `aws ce get-dimension-values --dimension SERVICE --time-period Start=...,End=...` in a real account, then move them into `map`. The code never reads `unverified`. Third-party Bedrock models (e.g. Claude) bill through AWS Marketplace under the model provider, not under Amazon Bedrock.
